image_description: A high-angle shot of an ornate pipe organ installed within a classical architectural niche. The organ features a symmetrical facade with vertical metal pipes of varying heights, gold-leaf detailing, and white painted wood casing. It is flanked by Corinthian-style columns and sits above a triangular pediment structure. The console (keyboards) is not visible in this frame.
